$description: Error messages. Follow 'what happened + what to do' pattern from copy-patterns.md — short, actionable, never 'Oops!' or 'Something went wrong'. Use %{placeholders} for dynamic values the caller substitutes at render time.

networkError.en: Connection lost. Check your network and try again.
networkError.zh-CN: 网络连接失败，请检查网络后重试。

serverError.en: Something is off on our side. Please try again in a moment.

sessionExpired.en: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
sessionExpired.zh-CN: 登录已过期，请重新登录。

outOfStock.en: Out of stock. Try one of these similar items.
outOfStock.zh-CN: 已售罄，可尝试以下类似商品。

itemUnavailable.en: This item is no longer available.

invalidCode.en: Invalid promo code. Check the code and try again.
invalidCode.zh-CN: 优惠码无效，请检查后重试。

minOrderNotMet.en: Minimum order of $%{amount} required for this coupon.
minOrderNotMet.zh-CN: 此优惠券需满 $%{amount} 可用。

invalidPhone.zh-CN: 请输入有效的电话号码。

invalidEmail.zh-CN: 请输入有效的邮箱地址。

passwordTooShort.en: Password must be at least %{min} characters.
passwordTooShort.zh-CN: 密码至少需要 %{min} 个字符。

paymentFailed.en: Payment failed. Verify your card details or try another method.
paymentFailed.zh-CN: 支付失败，请检查卡信息或更换支付方式。

addressNotDeliverable.en: We don't deliver to this address yet.
